planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno; only explicit wired pins are D2 (button ON), D3 (button OFF), and D13 (LED). No other electrical wiring overrides were provided.
No explicit pullup/active_high polarity for the buttons was given; digital_input polarity uses catalog default (application/model should interpret pressed as model=true without double-inversion).
No serial protocol requirements were provided in the input; therefore no serial_channels are configured.
No additional actuators/sensors (PWM, DHT, ultrasonic, servo, TM1637, shift-register, tone, bargraph) are specified; no corresponding requests are generated.
